Chapter 1382: 5: Lin Yuan And Gray Ancestor (Part 2)

Chapter 1382: Chapter 5: Lin Yuan and Gray Ancestor (Part 2)

Of course, treasures of this type are very valuable, roughly equivalent to the most precious below the Lord.

Moreover, some secret technique inheritances can yield similar effects.

In conflicts between time lives, the main reliance is on observing each other’s timeline.

If one party’s timeline cannot be observed, or is difficult to observe.

Then the advantages and disadvantages become quite apparent.

“Yet, I cannot observe your timeline, and you probably can’t see much of mine.”

Gray Ancestor, confident in demeanor, as an experienced Second Realm time life, had also cultivated some secret technique inheritances to obscure his timeline.

Lin Yuan did not speak.

In the perspective of the Lord’s status, the secret technique inheritance Gray Ancestor cultivated to obscure his timeline was nearly ineffective.

“Very hard to kill.”

Lin Yuan observed timeline after timeline, understanding Gray Ancestor’s methods, realizing he couldn’t kill the opponent.

Even if a great price was paid, leaving this flesh, Gray Ancestor could revive through life-preserving methods, not even considered ‘reviving,’ as it wasn’t true death.

“Still need the true body to be assured.”

Lin Yuan thought, after stepping into the Thirteenth Realm, the Taiji Primordial Spirit’s power greatly increased, closing the gap with the true body, but in terms of true combat power, naturally the true body was strongest.

So for safety’s sake, as the Taiji Primordial Spirit arrived shortly, the true body also moved to the vicinity.

…..

“Your target is also this Heart of Heavenly River? In that case, if you defeat me, you can take the Heart of Heavenly River.”

Gray Ancestor naturally was unwilling to give up the Heart of Heavenly River.

He had already traded with numerous time lives from the Taixu Dimension, patiently waiting for the Heart of Heavenly River to be born, and had already paid the ‘cost.’

A single intervention from a Second Realm time life wasn’t enough to make him relinquish it.

“Endless Gloom!”

With a flicker of mind, Gray Ancestor started to spread layers of grayness, covering Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan didn’t hesitate much, likewise unfolding his own domain.

By observing the future timelines, he knew if he held back, he would definitely suffer.

The mere initial collision of two enormous auras profoundly impacted the entire Milky Way Dimension, causing the space-time to rise like waves, while the movement of the Origin Dao of the Milky Way Dimension rapidly retreated.

“Go to the dimension gap.”

Lin Yuan glanced around and immediately moved outside the Milky Way Dimension.

Even a top-level dimensional space like the Milky Way Dimension could not withstand the battle between two Second Realm time lives.

Gray Ancestor had no objection to this.

Not out of kindness, but because his desired Heart of Heavenly River was also in the Milky Way Dimension.

If his battle with Lin Yuan affected the final birth of the Heart of Heavenly River.

Then it wouldn’t be in Gray Ancestor’s interest.

If the Heart of Heavenly River was lost, why would he battle with Lin Yuan here?

With a rumble.

In an instant, the battlefield shifted from within the Milky Way Dimension to the broad dimension gap.

This brought a slight relief to numerous time lives watching from afar, since the Milky Way Dimension was their territory, they naturally didn’t want any damage.

…

The dimension gap was vast and boundless.

Two enormous auras kept clashing, sending shockwaves sweeping in all directions.

“Since I have understood the Chaotic Origin Gloom Dao, I haven’t fully exerted myself much.” Gray Ancestor’s eyes were gray, seemingly connected to two bottomless abysses, “Come, let me see your strength.”

“Chaotic Origin Gloom Dao?” Lin Yuan’s expression was serious, as this Origin Dao was extremely unique, suppressing him multiple times in various future timelines.

Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!!!

The clash of two distinct auras dissolved all material illusions, even causing the dimension gap, which seemed submerged in still water, to start ‘boiling.’

“Is this the combat power of Second Realm time lives?”

“Too terrifying, if I get a bit closer, I guess even the shockwaves would inflict injuries.”

Time lives watching calmed themselves, as such a duel between two Second Realm time lives was rare.

Normally, Second Realm time lives seldom acted, like Gray Ancestor’s plan for the Heart of Heavenly River, if not for Lin Yuan’s intervention, he probably would obtain it silently.

“Hope Gray Ancestor wins.”

The Master of Taixu also paid close attention to the battlefield, having offended Lin Yuan, naturally hoping Gray Ancestor could smoothly repel the latter.

If Gray Ancestor obtained the Heart of Heavenly River and completed the trade with their Taixu Dimension, the final benefits would smoothly reach him.

With those benefits, the strength of the Master of Taixu would be elevated slightly, adding a bit of confidence facing Second Realm time lives.

…

“Worthy of the Origin Dao.” Lin Yuan felt the endless gloom emitted by Gray Ancestor, the essence of the Chaotic Origin Gloom Dao, sweeping over ordinary First Realm time lives with ease.

Only Lin Yuan, without comprehending the Chaotic Origin Dao, relying on his accumulated foundation was able to withstand it until now.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan looked at the surrounding world.

The gloomy aura pierced through space-time, forming a cage, suppressing Lin Yuan within.

“Taste the flavor of my Gloom World.”

Seeing Lin Yuan successfully suppressed in his Gloom World, Gray Ancestor smiled.

The Gloom World, condensed by Gray Ancestor’s Origin Dao, had rules entirely set by him.

Even a strong Second Realm time life would struggle to break free in the short term.

This move was meant to suppress, and Gray Ancestor desired that effect, only by holding Lin Yuan could he smoothly take the Heart of Heavenly River.

Taking the Heart of Heavenly River was the ultimate aim of Gray Ancestor.

As for Lin Yuan? In the brief confrontation earlier, Gray Ancestor perceived the marvelous accumulations of Lin Yuan’s foundation.

To kill such a time life, there were only two methods.

One was to annihilate with overwhelming force.

Such ‘overwhelming force,’ would need to reach at least the level of Third Realm Lords.

The other method was relying on the slow attrition over long years.

Gray Ancestor couldn’t manage the first method, nor was he inclined for the second.

“Rest assured, once the Heart of Heavenly River is taken, I’ll release you.”

Gray Ancestor looked down at Lin Yuan inside the Gloom World and spoke.

“Take the Heart of Heavenly River? You think you can take it?”

Lin Yuan suddenly spoke.

“What’s your meaning?”

Gray Ancestor was slightly surprised.

Without Lin Yuan, who among those First Realm time lives of the Milky Way Dimension could stop him?

As for the other Second Realm time lives in the adjacent dimension gap? They essentially wouldn’t make it in time.

Once the Heart of Heavenly River came into his possession, even with a few lingering hazards, Gray Ancestor could accept it.

With his strength, even if the other Second Realm time lives knew about the Heart of Heavenly River with Lord-level potential being in his possession, what could they do?

Of course, if possible, Gray Ancestor didn’t want the news of obtaining the Heart of Heavenly River to get out.

But since it couldn’t be concealed any longer, Gray Ancestor didn’t mind.

“With the Gloom World suppressing me, how much strength can you still exert?”

Lin Yuan smiled slightly.

Deep in the Gloom World, Lin Yuan naturally resisted.

With Lin Yuan’s strength, resisting and struggling would force Gray Ancestor to divert much of his strength to suppress.

“Even if I can only exert thirty to forty percent, no one can stop me.”

Gray Ancestor’s tone was calm, as thirty to forty percent of strength from a Second Realm time life surpassed a First Realm time life.

Moreover, those First Realm time lives didn’t know that Gray Ancestor needed to allocate much of his strength to suppress Lin Yuan now.

In this situation, who dared to obstruct?

“I’ll see, who dares obstruct me!”

Gray Ancestor didn’t dwell on it, intending to promptly return to the Milky Way Dimension.

Calculating the time, after several more breaths, the Heart of Heavenly River would be completely born.

Suddenly——

Gray Ancestor halted, gazing around.

By now, the surrounding space-time had transformed into chaos.

Above the firmament, a vast face appeared, gazing down on Gray Ancestor.

“This…”

Gray Ancestor’s heart trembled, the enormity of the face proportionate to one hundredth of the Milky Way Dimension, while the appearance of the face.

Was precisely Lin Yuan, whom Gray Ancestor had suppressed in the Gloom World.
